confirmed: The new product is a smaller, standalone Lifetide experience rather than another feature inside the current full product.
The core loop is short interview waves followed by immediate user-facing understanding, ending in three alternative life plans and continued conversation.
Resume, MBTI report and related material upload must remain available but optional.
The user-facing persona dashboard and full six-layer persona product are removed; a lightweight internal working memory remains for continuity and planning.
The intended audience is young adults, and the visual experience should feel fashionable, cool, modern, playful and less serious.
The implementation may be a full Next.js web product rather than a constrained H5 page.
Existing Lifetide visual assets may be reused when their provenance and license permit it.
Loom is the continuity and design-document infrastructure for this new workspace.

assumptions.text: The working product name is 潮生｜人生试玩 until naming is revisited after concept validation.

The first implementation will reuse infrastructure and licensed assets conceptually but will not share runtime code with the existing Lifetide repository until an explicit engineering decision is made.
Three-year alternative lives are a better consumer horizon than the source method's five-year Odyssey Plans; each route ends in a three-day reversible trial.

unresolved.question: Should anonymous progress persist only on-device, or should account creation be requested when users save plans or upload files?
Which exact existing sky backgrounds are user-owned and publishable outside the original Lifetide repository?

decisions.title: Hide the persona product, retain working memory
decisions.decision: The interface will not expose a persona dashboard or coverage model. The system retains evidence-linked working memory for adaptive questions, immediate insights and plan generation.
decisions.rationale: Deleting internal understanding would make questions repetitive and plans generic; exposing the full model creates unnecessary user and product complexity.

decisions.title: Use short value-delivery waves
decisions.decision: Each wave contains three to five questions and ends with an immediate insight plus user calibration controls.
decisions.rationale: Short waves make the reward immediate and let correction improve the next wave.

decisions.title: Modern web product, not mandatory H5 wrapper
decisions.decision: Design for a mobile-first responsive Next.js web application with desktop expansion and installable PWA potential.
decisions.rationale: This preserves link-based distribution while allowing richer visual direction, uploads and durable sessions.

decisions.title: Custom visual system over a themed component kit
decisions.decision: Use shadcn/ui as accessible structural primitives, Motion for interaction, and a small curated subset of React Bits or Magic UI source components for effects. Art direction remains custom.
decisions.rationale: Component libraries can accelerate mechanics but cannot supply a coherent brand; unrestricted effect libraries would make the product look like a generic AI landing page.
